doc.name: A — lighting fixtures catalogue, workshop bench, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: opal glass pendant lamp
Category: lighting fixtures
Shot programme: workshop bench
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You run the tabletop stage for a premium lighting fixtures product shoot. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the dead-on front elevation in a workshop bench treatment.

SUBJECT. A opal glass pendant lamp. Copy the product from the reference verbatim in form and finish. If a detail is unreadable in the reference, keep it neutral rather than inventing one.

CAMERA. Straight-on front elevation, lens at exact label centre, zero perspective distortion. Shoot on a 24-70mm zoom at the long end at f/1.2, framing for frame-within-frame using foreground architecture.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject. Stage the product on or against matte acrylic, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
